name: asana
description: Asana as a ticket provider: tasks in the configured projects become ticket records, completion and section moves become ticket-status-change events, task comments become ticket-comment documents, and the host can comment on a task (ticket.comment) and move it to a workflow column (ticket.transition: complete/reopen, or a section mapped to that column), and list the workspaces, projects and sections the source can be configured with (ticket.containers). It also keeps one Asana webhook per configured project pointed at the source's public hook URL (push.subscribe / push.unsubscribe); a signed delivery only wakes the next sync. Synced by the host's connector driver: a full crawl per project, then that project's Events API sync token; the plugin only maps Asana's REST API.
author: Papercusp
